summary: Iteration 118 — Verified (1) per-card accent scoping on /c/:cardId and (2) stories-with-location backend + camera story place picker UI. Backend 2/2 pytest passing: POST /api/stories/ with location {lat:4.6486,lng:-74.0628,name:'Café QA',address:'Calle 63',place_id:'osm-qa'} returns id; GET /api/stories/located returns the story with place_name='Café QA', lat/lng present; DELETE /api/stories/{id} works (owner only). Saved place POST /api/places/saved + GET works. Frontend (mobile 390x844, newtest@bruno.com): ViewCardPage /c/de078d9e… has data-card-accent='#1e40af' and computed --primary='226 71% 40%' on [data-testid=view-card-page], while html[data-accent]='orange' and document.documentElement --primary='25 100% 50%' (global orange UNCHANGED). After navigating to /reels, global stays orange. Second card /c/d16c2745… applies data-card-accent='#FF6B35' → --primary='16 100% 60%' scoped. Builder /cards/new?type=personal → preset-custom → use-style-btn → tab-design: data-testid=accent-hint renders next to color-accent with the expected copy ('El acento también colorea los botones y controles de la página al ver tu tarjeta, sin cambiar el color de la app de quien la mira.'). StoryPlacePicker: /camera → gallery picker-confirm → camera-as-story-toggle → camera-story-place-toggle opens story-place-picker (visible, lists saved place button story-place-osm-qa-cafe); clicking it updates the toggle label to 'Café QA Chapinero'. CRITICAL BUG: The actual story publish from camera FAILS in-browser due to a mixed-content 307: axios POSTs to '${API}/stories' (no trailing slash) at BrunoCameraPage.jsx:715 and StoryEditor.jsx:320; the backend prefix mounts @router.post('/') so FastAPI 307-redirects to '/api/stories/' — the ingress Location header downgrades the scheme to http://, which Chromium blocks as mixed-content, so the toast 'Historia publicada' never fires and the story is not created. Verified directly: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}' -X POST https://premium-launch-13.preview.emergentagent.com/api/stories` → '307 http://premium-launch-13.preview.emergentagent.com/api/stories/'. The backend route itself is correct and the pytest flow passes (requests lib follows 307 same-method). Fix is a one-char change at each call site: append the trailing slash. Same bug affects any browser-based story creation (Camera + StoryEditor), not just the new place feature.

integration_issues.issue: axios POST '${API}/stories' (no trailing slash) hits FastAPI 307 redirect to '/api/stories/'. Behind the Kubernetes ingress the Location header is written as http:// (not https://), so browsers block the redirected POST as mixed-content. Result: story is never created, no toast, UI shows 'Falló la subida. Puedes reintentar sin perder tu video.' Fix: use '${API}/stories/' at BrunoCameraPage.jsx:715 and StoryEditor.jsx:320. (Pytest with requests passes because it follows the redirect in-scheme.)

rca of the issue: FastAPI's APIRouter(prefix='/stories') + @router.post('/') exposes the route only at '/api/stories/'. Hitting '/api/stories' triggers Starlette's redirect_slashes 307 whose Location is built from request.url.replace(path='…/'); behind this Kubernetes ingress the inbound scheme header is interpreted as http://, so the 307 Location is written as 'http://…/api/stories/'. Browsers downgrade-blocking kicks in and the retried POST is cancelled as mixed-content; the python `requests` library follows the redirect anyway on the same host which is why the backend test is green. Fix is a one-char change on each FE call site (BrunoCameraPage.jsx:715, StoryEditor.jsx:320). Alternative permanent fix: set FastAPI(redirect_slashes=False) and declare @router.post('') or expose both path variants. Either way the FE change is the quickest unblock.
